metadata.description: Prooftrail — does your AI coding agent follow the rules you set? Checked at the end of every turn, locally and for free.

plugins.name: prooftrail
plugins.description: Prooftrail — checks your AI coding agent against the rules you set, at the end of every turn. Reads your AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md and verifies the rules that can be checked mechanically — did the tests run, did they run after the last edit, did it finish the work. Runs locally with no account needed; add a hosted judge for the rules that need judgment. Advisory: it never blocks.
